prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Pearland, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1071; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?

A: It was at an intersection in Pearland, Texas, on a weekday afternoon. I was heading through the intersection when the other car came toward me from the opposite direction.

Q: Were you going straight or turning?

A: I was going straight. The other driver was making a left turn across my lane, or at least that's how it seemed to me.

Q: How fast were you traveling when the vehicles made contact?

A: Not fast. I'd say I was barely moving, maybe ten or fifteen miles an hour. Both of us braked, but we still met head-on.

Q: Did either airbag deploy?

A: No, nothing deployed. It felt more like a hard jolt than a crash.

Q: Did you hit your head or lose consciousness?

A: No, I didn't hit my head and I didn't black out. I stayed in the seat and was able to get out of the car on my own.

Q: When did you first notice any pain or stiffness?

A: Honestly, the next morning. My neck felt tight, and by that evening my lower back was sore too. It's gotten a little worse since then.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or other medical provider for this?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care a couple of days later. They diagnosed a neck strain and a lower back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and a referral for physical therapy.

Q: Do you have any prior injuries or problems with your neck or back?

A: Nothing serious. I had some stiffness years ago that went away with stretching, but I haven't needed treatment for it in a long time.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want to get back to normal. I'm still having trouble sitting for long periods and I've missed a few days of work because of it.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
